variants.title: Capacitive level probe in transformer oil
variants.sample: Mineral transformer oil, relative permittivity about 2.2
variants.unknown: the level of oil in an unknown tank
variants.note: Oil has a low permittivity, so the capacitance changes only a little with level and the sensitivity is about 70 times smaller than in water. The value 2.2 is a typical figure for mineral insulating oil, not a looked-up one (unsourced / illustrative).

source.title: Relative permittivity of mineral insulating oil about 2.2 (typical, not looked up)
